metadata.title: Pop Album Cover with Psychedelic Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast pop portrait featuring bold, custom psychedelic lettering and a background of horizontal scanlines over a red-to-purple gradient.

recipe.visualDefinition: A female subject in a white tank top and ornate gold jewelry is positioned on the right, set against a vibrant red and purple background featuring a large circular motif filled with horizontal scanlines. The top left is dominated by heavy, custom-lettered display type with exaggerated swashes and curls.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject positioned right-of-center balancing heavy typography on the left
Horizontal scanlines within a circular frame contrasting with the organic subject
Vibrant red and purple color palette unifying the graphic and photographic elements
Handwritten script in the lower left providing a secondary focal point
coreInvariants: Exaggerated curly swashes on the display typography
Uniform horizontal scanline pattern within the circular graphic
High-contrast lighting on the subject's face and jewelry

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is a medium-close-up portrait occupying the right two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, white display typography in the upper left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bold white text to the subject's face, then down to the jewelry and the handwritten script.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The left side is filled with graphic patterns and text, leaving little true negative space.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep red and magenta gradient background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for the primary display typography and subject's clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Gold from the jewelry and black for the secondary script.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the background with high value contrast between the white text and dark red tones.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold flared serif with psychedelic influences.
letterConstructionRules: Variable stroke width with extreme contrast
Circular motifs integrated into letter counters
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Y' and 'A' feature long, curling descenders and crossbars
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of heavy, geometric psychedelic display type with a fluid, casual monoline script.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 70s psychedelic flared serif aesthetic.
The specific curls and spirals require manual vector adjustment.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman in a white tank top with gold jewelry on the right side. The background should be a red and purple gradient with a large circle on the left containing horizontal black scanlines.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, white, custom psychedelic lettering with curly swashes in the top left. Add a black monolinear handwritten script in the bottom left.

verificationChecks: Check for the spiral 'O' in the display text
Confirm the script is tilted and monolinear

mustRedesign: Generic fonts must be replaced with custom-curled vector lettering
Flat backgrounds must be replaced with the scanline/gradient combo

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of graphic and photographic elements

postGenerationChecks: Is the typography heavy and psychedelic?
Are the scanlines contained within a circular area?
Is the color palette dominated by red and purple?
Is the subject's jewelry clearly visible and detailed?
recipe.reuseFormula: Pop Portrait + Psychedelic Swash Type + Scanline Gradient Background
